about: The polish cases: one for each of the 15 places where the new tools didn't do what their design said, found in the polish pass (1 to 15), and one for each later fix (101 on). sfsharness polish reads every .json file in this folder. Written as data, in the shape of the trap cases: the calls to make and what must be true of the answers. A case passes when every condition of any one 'pass_if' entry holds. 'via': 'cli' runs SFSearch.exe with the args (the answer is the verb's whole text, [cost] line included, and the exit code is the verb's own); a call with 'tool' goes through the service's structured form; 'powershell' runs a line in PowerShell. Conditions: matches, not_matches (.NET regular expressions on part out, notes or all), code (the exact exit code), tables_ruled (every table has its separator row). Placeholders: {data} the Data folder, {fx} the case's own folder under the work folder, {exe} SFSearch.exe quoted for PowerShell.
